description: This dataset tracks total phosphorus concentrations in Lake Constance, specifically at the Fischbach-Uttwil monitoring station. It provides annual measurements from 1951 to 2009, capturing both winter mixing periods for the entire water column and summer averages for the upper twenty meters. The data includes precise geographic coordinates and elevation details, allowing for spatial analysis of water quality trends over time. Researchers can utilize this information to study long-term eutrophication patterns, assess the effectiveness of environmental management strategies, and understand seasonal variations in nutrient levels within this significant alpine lake ecosystem.
